summary: note_entity gets a writer: the note tier's merge is no longer inert. Anchor-entity strings now resolve against the shared fact-entity registry on every note write, and a new Dreamer pass resolves the near-misses exact matching cannot settle.
details: Issue #100. `SqlNoteStore.create`/`propose` resolve each `anchor_entity_ids` string against `fact_entity`'s canonical names and aliases (exact match after normalisation, via `SqlEntityStore.resolve`, never `resolve_or_create` — this tier links to an entity that already exists and never mints one) and write `note_entity` rows in the same transaction as the note. `InMemoryNoteStore` gained the identical optional `resolver` collaborator so the contract suite exercises both implementations on the real write path.

`nora.language.note_entity_adaptor.NoteEntityResolutionAdaptor` is the judgement half, mirroring `FactEntityResolutionAdaptor`'s shape over the same `fact_entity` table: workspace-keyed, watermark-free, tool-free, and its only write is attaching an alias — it never merges or creates an entity row. Rides `[notes] curator_enabled` (no flag of its own): its sole consumer is the curator's merge key, so an operator who has not turned the curator on has nothing that would read what it writes.

`SqlEntityStore.unresolved_note_anchor_names` is the note tier's own near-miss queue, reading standing notes' `anchor_entity_ids` the same way `unresolved_names` reads `fact_candidate`'s pending subjects for the fact tier.

`nora_note_entity_resolutions_total`, `nora_note_entity_resolution_offered_total`, and `nora_note_entity_aliases_attached_total` are the new counters, matching the fact tier's own three-series shape for pass 6.
limitations: Still requires `[facts] enabled` for anything to resolve against: the note tier has no registry of its own, only a narrower reader/writer of the fact tier's `fact_entity`.

No embeddings-based near-miss channel — the judgement pass reaches only what deterministic exact matching and the fact tier's trigram similarity surface; an entity known only by an abbreviation the trigram index cannot reach stays unresolved.
